comment: Privacy-respecting analytics config for the marketing shell. Default-deny: nothing that identifies a visitor runs before opt-in. Baseline measurement is cookieless and aggregate (no cookies, no cross-site identifiers, no PII) so it needs NO consent banner; only the optional `marketing` category requires consent. Equal-prominence accept/reject is mandatory (2026 consent law). Server-side ingest is preferred to survive ad-blockers without tracking the user.

categories.label: Essential
categories.description: Strictly necessary for the site to function (e.g. CDN, security). No tracking.

categories.label: Anonymous analytics
categories.description: Cookieless, aggregate page/section metrics. No cookies, no cross-site IDs, no PII; not joinable to an individual — runs without a banner.

categories.label: Marketing
categories.description: Campaign attribution / remarketing signals. OFF until explicit opt-in; gated behind consent.

transport.comment: First-party, server-side ingest endpoint. Recovers lost signal without browser fingerprinting; events are validated against the per-app `analytics.events` allowlist in app.manifest.json.
